source: Укрінформ (police estimate, via Radio Svoboda and Bukvy)
note: The city peak came on day 16, not at the start: police estimated about 6,000 people at the 31 July all-Ukrainian march. The peak remains contested because published estimates ranged from about 1,000 early in the march to organiser claims of up to 15,000 and qualitative reports of tens of thousands. A repeat march on 16 August drew roughly 1,000–1,500. The final small Kyiv actions drew no more than about 30 on 18 August; on 19 August about 100 gathered near parliament in the morning and about 30 attended the evening gathering. Parliament approved Yevhen Khmara on 19 August and the coordinated campaign closed. Last documented Kyiv action: 2026-08-19; 30 distinct documented action days.

quote_uk: спочатку людей було близько 100, але за пів години їх побільшало орієнтовно до 300
quote_en: at first about 100 people, but within half an hour the number grew to roughly 300
source: MediaPort (own correspondent); Suspilne national round-up gives «щонайменше 300»
note: Peak of roughly 300, corroborated by two independent sources: MediaPort on the scene, which watched the crowd grow from 100 to 300 within half an hour, and the Suspilne national round-up («щонайменше 300»). Police via Suspilne Kharkiv gave «близько 200» at 12:10, a later snapshot after part of the crowd had left, not a refutation of the peak. «Десятки» at 09:24 is a slice taken while the crowd was still gathering. One action, not two: Svobody Square, Shevchenko Garden and Universytet metro are one site; during an air-raid alert the rally moved into the metro underpass for about ten minutes. Day 3 (18 Jul): police counted «близько 400 людей» at 20:00 (Suspilne day-3 round-up), the wave high; the category is unchanged. Police counted the city repeatedly through the second week: «близько 350 людей» at 20:00 on 20 July, «близько 250» on 24 July, «до 150» on 25 July, «близько 180» on 26 July, «близько 90» on 28 July, «близько півсотні» on 30 July. The day-4 450 remains the peak. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-19; 19 distinct documented action days.

quote_uk: Загалом до акції долучилися близько пів тисячі людей.
quote_en: about 500 people joined the action overall
note: The opening-day trajectory was «близько ста» (09:34), «кількасот» (10:53), then «близько 300». The 31 July march report initially said about 100 at the assembly point and was updated after the march to about 500 overall, making it the city's documented peak. The most persistent location after Kyiv: Dnipro.media numbered its own local actions and reached the 23rd by 6 August, more than the wave's day count, because some days carried two. By 5–6 August the format changed to a silent protest, «тиха акція» with «щонайменше 50 людей». RANDOM AUDIT 1 SEP: last documented action 2026-08-29; 35 distinct documented action days. The coordinated daily series ended on 19 August, but a re-formatted local action with about 15 people was documented on 29 August.

Suspilne Lviv has an article but gives no figure in the body, hence ZAXID as the source. Svobody Avenue, by the Shevchenko monument. Days 12-21 sit in a narrow band: «близько сотні» (27 Jul, NV) against «близько 150» from the police the same day (UP), «близько 200» on 28 and 30 July, «кілька сотень» for the 31 July march to Rynok Square, «близько півтора сотні» on 5 August. RANDOM AUDIT 1 SEP: the 4 August Korrespondent roundup adds one documented action day; last documented action 2026-08-18; 24 distinct documented action days.

Two waves. The morning action ran until 11:00, then participants dispersed and regathered at 13:00 ahead of the parliamentary session. The «ОНОВЛЕНО. 13:30» block reads «понад 60, і люди продовжують підходити»; below it, «понад сто людей» about the 13:00 gathering. Day 2 (17 Jul): a second-day action was called for 18:00 opposite the City Garden (OBOZ); Day 4 (19 Jul) was far larger: «На вулиці Дерибасівській зібралися близько тисячі людей» (24 Kanal, citing Suspilne) — a ~7× surge from day 1 and the Odesa wave peak. «Близько тисячі» sits at the 1000 boundary and is single-source, so it is marked contested and taken as 1000+ by the «близько сотні»→100–999 convention; day-1 «понад сто» and the day-2 18:00 action are the earlier points. Day 16 (31 Jul): «близько 200 осіб» took part in the march (Suspilne Odesa), an order below the contested day-4 «близько тисячі», which remains the peak. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-18; 19 distinct documented action days.

«Акція не має терміну тривалості». Correspondents give «орієнтовно дві сотні людей», police «орієнтовно 200». The early 0342.ua slice, «десятки», is 09:34, while the crowd was gathering. Day 2 (17 Jul): people gathered again on the square by the oblast administration (Suspilne); no separate day-2 count was confirmed, so «орієнтовно 200» stands. (A day-1 relay, Halyckyj korespondent via Censor, gave «близько трьох сотень».) Settled to took place. Among the most persistent locations, covered daily by Suspilne Ivano-Frankivsk, pravda.if.ua, Informator and Firtka. The band over days 11-17 was 50-100, rising to 200 for the 1 August march («У Франківську на 17 день акцій до протестної ходи долучилися 200 людей», Suspilne). 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-19; 28 distinct documented action days.

0352.ua at 10:45 gives «понад сотня людей», which is growth rather than a contradiction. RANDOM AUDIT 1 SEP: a Korrespondent roundup confirms an additional action on 4 August; 9 distinct documented action days.

An apparent contradiction resolved as a time slice: «біля 50» at 9:05, «близько сотні» at 9:20, «приблизно сотня» at 9:30. A march ran from the Dytiachyi Svit mall to Independence Square. The article dateModified reads 14:38, but the text is the morning version: the figure is valid for roughly 09:30.

Two waves. «Акцію призупинили через півтори години»; participants regathered at 13:30 and the action continued as of 14:00. Suspilne gives no figure for the second wave. Lutsk added a demand absent elsewhere: the dismissal of Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi. The Suspilne article dateModified moved from 14:04 to 15:57 during verification while the body stayed byte-identical. Day 2 (17 Jul): «орієнтовно пів сотні людей» on Teatralnyi Maidan in the morning (Suspilne, NV); the day-1 «близько сотні» remains the peak. Settled to took place. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-19; 9 distinct documented action days.

Growth from roughly 30 at 09:44, recorded by two independent sources, TSN and dzvin.media, to roughly 100. The action was self-organised through social media. RANDOM AUDIT 1 SEP: the 4 August Korrespondent roundup adds one documented action day; last documented action 2026-08-18; 13 distinct documented action days.
New in the 15:00 run. At 13:00 no figure existed in any of the six sources checked. A dialogue-police count now exists. Independence Square, by the city council.

At 13:00 Suspilne carried no figure, and NV's «близько сотні» was treated as a false attribution. NV was in fact ahead of Suspilne, which now carries that figure. Local outlets poltava.to and kolo.news counted «близько 70» themselves. Theatre Square. REVISED in the 6 Aug run: the peak is day 5, not day 1 — «близько 20:00 у центрі міста зібралися орієнтовно 130 людей» (Suspilne Poltava). «Майже вісім десятків» on 24 July, «понад сотню» for the 31 July march.

Held despite an air-raid alert. Relatives of fallen soldiers attended, including a woman carrying a photograph of her son killed near Pokrovsk. Shevchenko Boulevard, opposite the city council. The article dateModified reads 15:07, but the text is the morning version: the figure is valid for 09:48. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-17; 11 distinct documented action days.

quote_uk: до акції долучилися півтори сотні людей
quote_en: a hundred and fifty people joined the action
note: A rare case: an own count with two time points. Censor independently confirms «близько 60 учасників» at 09:30. The city was absent from the announcement. REVISED UPWARD in the 6 Aug run: on day 4 co-organiser Denys Markov told Suspilne «до акції долучилися півтори сотні людей», moving the city from <100 to 100–999. Police counted 66 on 20 July, and Hrechka reported «близько 30 учасників» as the stable core by 26 July. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-18; 14 distinct documented action days.

source: Suspilne Uzhhorod (National Police of Zakarpattia spokesperson Kateryna Petrunio)
note: The 15:00 run added police attribution; at 13:00 the figure had no source. Still a single-source location: no Zakarpattia outlet covered the topic. Participants opened with a minute of silence. Uzhhorod was absent from the announcement. CONTESTED after the 6 Aug run, and a textbook headline-inflation case. Ukrinform's day-3 piece is headlined «В Ужгороді кількість мітингувальників на підтримку Федорова зросла до двох сотень», but its body gives no absolute number at all — only its own correspondent's «нині на зібрання прийшло майже вдвічі більше людей, аніж раніше». Under §3.6 the figure is taken from the body, so the verified absolute counts stand: «близько 50» (police, day 1), «близько 20 осіб» on 30 July (Censor, OBOZ), and «лише 12 людей» on 5 August, where participants told Novyny.LIVE that «зазвичай протестувальників понад три десятки». Uzhhorod is among the most persistent locations in the dataset. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-12; 25 distinct documented action days.

The only city where the action was interrupted. At 10:00 protesters stopped and went to Independence Square to pay respects to the family of a fallen defender. REVISED UPWARD in the 6 Aug run: Rivne peaked well above its day-1 fifty. «Майже 100 людей» on 21 July (Suspilne), «понад 50» on 24 July, «понад 40» on 27 July, «приблизно тридцять» on 28 July, then back to «приблизно сто людей» for the 31 July march and «близько ста людей» on 1 August (Rayon.in.ua). Chetverta Vlada counted «близько 150 людей» itself on 24 July, above Suspilne's figure for the same day. RANDOM AUDIT 1 SEP: the 4 August Korrespondent roundup adds one documented action day; last documented action 2026-08-19; 14 distinct documented action days.

Three-day peak; the crowd grew across the wave. Day 1 (16 Jul): «Біля міської ради зібралися 45 людей» (Suspilne Mykolaiv, 11:02; a march along Soborna Street; the national round-up carried the stale «26 людей»), <100. Day 3 (18 Jul): «понад 150 людей» joined (Suspilne day-3 round-up), moving Mykolaiv into 100–999. The clearest decay curve in the dataset, counted almost daily by the dialogue police via Suspilne Mykolaiv: 80 (20 Jul), 35 (21 Jul), 30 (22 Jul), «понад 50» (24 Jul), 55 (25 Jul), 32 (26 Jul), 35 (27 Jul), 25 (28 Jul), and «близько 12 людей» on 3 August. Hard.City noted people gather daily at 18:00 and stand until at least 20:00. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-17; 21 distinct documented action days.

quote_en: almost 150 activists marched through the streets
note: Central Square. Dialogue police were present. Slogans: «Армії - дрони, а не погони», «Працює - не чіпай». REVISED UPWARD in the 6 Aug run: Chernivtsi joined the all-Ukrainian march on 31 July with «майже 150 активістів» (Molodyi Bukovynets), moving it from <100 to 100–999. Days 1-5 stayed at «кілька десятків».

Korolov Square by the oblast administration. The city was absent from the announcement. REVISED UPWARD in the 6 Aug run: day 5 grew from «близько 50 учасників» to «близько 70 житомирян» by 21:00 (Suspilne Zhytomyr); the city stays <100. Zhytomyr.info later reviewed how local media covered the protests. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-18; 9 distinct documented action days.

A different modality, owing to proximity to the front: single pickets by the Sadko fountain plus cardboard signs left on railings and benches around the city. KP.UA reported the action had been cancelled. Refuted by an on-scene report with photographs: «Попри безпекову ситуацію, у Сумах люди вийшли на вулиці». The signs are being torn down. Suspilne has no Sumy material at all. Day 2 (17 Jul): «близько двох десятків людей» again (OBOZ). Settled to took place. No coverage after day 2 in any source checked in the 6 Aug run. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-18; 5 distinct documented action days.

The 25th location and the smallest action. Found only by the gazetteer sweep of 499 cities; it appears in no round-up. Single source; a targeted search produced no second confirmation. Outside the town hall. Far more persistent than the day-1 snapshot suggested: Suspilne Ivano-Frankivsk's daily round-ups place Kolomyia among the protesting towns on most days of the wave, and UKR.NET reported on 26 July that «В Коломиї активісти не припиняють акції». No figure after day 1.

quote_en: over a hundred and fifty people
note: Suspilne has material but only participant quotes, no count. The location, Krasna Square, appears in 0462.ua alone. Slogan: «Федоров+. Україна+. Поверніть ефективного МО». NO LONGER unknown: on day 5 Suspilne Chernihiv reported «понад півтори сотні людей» on Krasna Square, the first crowd figure this city produced. IMI later analysed how Chernihiv media covered the wave, noting Suspilne Chernihiv filed more than ten pieces, the most of any local outlet.

A march from the flagpole in Heroiv Park to the 95 Kvartal roundabout. «Сотні людей» in 056.ua is an aggregate estimate covering Dnipro, Kryvyi Rih and Kyiv together; assigning it to this city alone would be an error. Suspilne has no separate desk here. A 24 July report confirms another action («У Кривому Розі також триває картонний мітинг»); 0564.ua covered the paid-protest allegation. No city-level figure was published.

Not an oblast capital. Absent from every round-up processed at 13:00, though KP.UA lists it. Victory Square, «кореспонденти з місця події». Still no crowd figure anywhere, but no longer a one-source city: Kremenchutskyi Telehraf and Kremenchutska Hazeta covered it through the whole wave, reporting «Кременчук стоїть уже 21-й день» on 5 August and an action interrupted by an air-raid alert on 25 July. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-19; 10 distinct documented action days.

quote_uk: Через безпекову ситуацію жителі Херсона долучаються до акції онлайн
quote_en: Owing to the security situation, Kherson residents are joining the action online
note: Kherson joined online because the security situation made a street gathering unsafe. The article's photographs show actions in other cities. No Kherson street action was documented during the full collection period.

New on day 4 (19 Jul). Zakarpattia's second city (~85k); appears in the national day-4 round-ups (LB, UP, 24 Kanal) among the cities that protested, with no crowd figure published. Covered again on days 5-6 alongside Uzhhorod by Suspilne Uzhhorod and Focus; still no crowd figure.

New on day 4 (19 Jul). Dnipropetrovsk oblast (~220k); listed by 5.ua among the day-4 protest cities (Kharkiv, Odesa, Kamianske, Dnipro...), with no crowd figure. No further coverage after day 4. 1 SEP UPDATE: last documented action 2026-08-13; 2 distinct documented action days.

New on day 4 (19 Jul), caught by the gazetteer-grep of the day-4 round-ups (it was in a 24 Kanal per-city subsection, not the comma-list). «Невеличкий мітинг в Умані» with video; no crowd figure. Cherkasy oblast, ~83k. No further coverage after day 4.

quote_uk: Мирні акції проти відставки ексміністра оборони Михайла Федорова відбуваються в Ізмаїлі з 16 липня
quote_en: Peaceful rallies against the defence minister's dismissal have been held in Izmail since 16 July
note: NEW in the 6 Aug run, and a backfill: Suspilne Odesa states the rallies have run in Izmail since 16 July, so the town was active from day 1 and was missed by the original snapshot. Only day 5 is separately documented, hence days_active = 1. Espreso corroborates («Акції також пройшли в Ізмаїлі, де молодь зібралася в центрі міста») and Radio Svoboda lists it on 21 July. No crowd figure published. Odesa oblast, ~70k.

quote_uk: У Калуші понад 50 людей другий день поспіль зібралися біля будівлі районної державної адміністрації
quote_en: In Kalush more than 50 people gathered outside the district administration for a second day running
note: NEW in the 6 Aug run, and a direct correction to the previous snapshot's §5. Kalush was one of the four towns a rival Telegram map flagged on 17 July and for which the 19 July run found NO verifiable media source, so it was left off the map. It now has one: Suspilne Ivano-Frankivsk's own correspondent reported «понад 50 людей другий день поспіль» on 20 July — «другий день» dating the first Kalush action to 19 July. Ivano-Frankivsk oblast, ~65k.

quote_uk: Акцію провели 19 липня біля пам'ятника Тарасу Шевченку, передає Район.Шептицький
quote_en: The rally was held on 19 July by the Taras Shevchenko monument, Raion.Sheptytskyi reports
note: NEW in the 6 Aug run. Found only through UKR.NET relays, whose originals resolve to the local outlet Raion.Sheptytskyi; that outlet is not indexed by the search route used here, so the town appears in no national round-up. Its second-day piece (19 July) and third-day piece (21 July) date the first action to 18 July. The town council's position on the new rules for mass events is discussed in the third-day piece. No crowd figure. Lviv oblast, formerly Chervonohrad, ~65k.

quote_uk: В Олександрії о 17:00 25 людей зібралися на Соборній площі
quote_en: In Oleksandriia 25 people gathered on Soborna Square at 17:00
note: NEW in the 6 Aug run, and a backfill into the original period: Suspilne Kropyvnytskyi covered Oleksandriia's first action on day 4 in the same piece as Kropyvnytskyi's fourth — «19 липня у Кропивницькому четвертий день, а в Олександрії вперше мітингували». Single source, one documented day, exact count with a timestamp. Kirovohrad oblast, ~75k.

quote_uk: За інформацією видання ЖАР.INFO, у Кам'янці-Подільському протести тривають уже чотири дні поспіль
quote_en: According to ZHAR.INFO, protests in Kamianets-Podilskyi have run for four days in a row
note: NEW in the 6 Aug run. Two independent mentions: Podillya News on 21 July, relaying the local outlet ZHAR.INFO and dating the start to 18 July, and NV's 30 July round-up, which lists Kamianets-Podilskyi among the cities that protested that day. Neither publishes a crowd figure and no piece by ZHAR.INFO itself was retrievable, so the town is carried as a relay-sourced location. Khmelnytskyi oblast, ~100k.
